import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {

    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"language\":\"starlark\"}", ProcessConfig::class.java)
    val result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("def hello(): pass", config)
